key_doctrine: Prior inconsistent statement = impeachment only under FRE 613 unless it was made under oath at formal proceeding (FRE 801(d)(1)(A)). California § 1235 removes oath requirement — in California, all prior inconsistent statements are substantive evidence. Always check jurisdiction before characterizing the statement's use.
